_comment: 1.8.5 Village Restoration. The old village square has six lots. Each room has bundles: short shopping lists the player fills with items (or coins) whenever they like; partly filled bundles keep what was given. When every bundle in a room is full the room is rebuilt and its reward turns on for good. A bundle's wants map an item id to a count; 'coins' is coins. minStar 1 or 2 asks for silver or gold items. Rooms with soon: true are shown as ruins that open in a later update (no bundles yet). villager signs the letter that arrives when the room is finished. Code: src/systems/Restoration.ts, src/systems/RestorationEffects.ts, the square scene src/world/SquareView.ts.

rooms.name: The Pantry
rooms.about: Rosa's old shop front is boarded up. Fill her baskets and the Pantry opens again.

reward.text: Rosa sells rare seeds every day. Plant one for a better chance of silver and gold crops.

letter.title: The Pantry is open!
letter.body:
Dear {farmer},

I can hardly believe it. The Pantry has its shop front back, and the first thing I did was put the kettle on.

I have set aside some rare seeds for you. You will find them at my stall in the village square, a few every day. Plant one in a field and the harvest should be something special.

With flour on my apron and love in my heart,
Rosa

rooms.name: The Barn Room
rooms.about: The old animal shelter has lost its roof. Bring what your animals make and it will be rebuilt.

reward.text: All your animals make their products 10% sooner.

letter.title: The shelter has a roof!
letter.body:
Dear {farmer},

The animal shelter is finished and it is the BEST. There is straw everywhere and I have named all the sparrows.

I asked the animals on your farm and they say thank you. They are going to work a bit faster for you from now on. Their words, not mine.

Your friend,
Pip

rooms.name: The Pier
rooms.about: Old Tom's fishing pier has fallen into the sea. It will be rebuilt in a later update.

reward.text: A second fishing spot with new fish.

rooms.name: The Kitchen
rooms.about: The village kitchen is a pile of bricks. It will be rebuilt in a later update.

reward.text: A new workshop: the Village Kitchen.

rooms.name: The Workshop
rooms.about: Bram's forge is cold and rusty. It will be rebuilt in a later update.

rooms.name: The Treasury
rooms.about: The town hall and its clock stopped long ago. Fill the treasury and the village gets its heart back.

reward.text: Delivery trucks pay 15% more, and every Saturday is village market day: orders and your roadside stall pay 10% more.

letter.title: The clock is ticking again!
letter.body:
Dear {farmer},

Listen. Can you hear that? The town hall clock is ticking again, for the first time in years.

From now on the delivery trucks will pay you a little more, and every Saturday we hold a proper village market day: your orders and your roadside stall will pay 10% more. I may have had something to do with that.

With great thanks,
Hazel
